title: Scholarship student
description: Scholarship and bursary of about £420 a month. Halls paid by the scholarship. No debt, steady habits.

title: Scottish student
description: Edinburgh student with a monthly SAAS loan and Young Students' Bursary. Free buses, a summer Fringe job.

title: Commuter student
description: Lives with family and takes the train in with a 16-25 Railcard. Grant plus family help. Saving for a deposit.

title: Full loan student
description: Second year in Newcastle on the full maintenance loan in 3 payments. Tight summer, big spending on loan day.

title: Working student
description: Maintenance loan plus weekly bar shifts with pay that changes. Often in the overdraft.

title: Mature student
description: 29-year-old nursing student in Birmingham. Loan, NHS support grant and bank shifts. Careful with money.

title: International student
description: From China, studying in Coventry. Parents send money each month by Wise (yuan to pounds). Eats out a lot.

title: Final year with internship
description: Paid summer internship in London, saved into a Lifetime ISA, then a holiday and busy nights out in Exeter.

title: Rich student
description: About £2,000 a month from parents. Rents a city flat, many subscriptions, Klarna for clothes.

title: Recent graduate
description: Graduated in summer, started a London graduate job in September. First salary, first London rent.
